questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg var i høj grad motiveret af sprog. Jeg ville gerne forbedre mit franske så jeg havde Paris og Bruxelles som prioriteter

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg elskede at være på udveksling. Det er så fedt at komme væk fra alle sine daglige forpligtelser og bare udforske en ny by og hygge en masse. Kæmpe plus at man bare skal bestå sine eksaminer så det er også et semester hvor man ikke behøves at fokuserer så meget på det akademiske:))

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes det var ok nemt. Man fik tilsendt det meste på mail

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: ULB (det belgiske universitet) sendte en hel 'velkoms pamflet' med ret meget info. Derudver, skrev jeg til en der tidligere havde været afsted, som var mega hjælpsom

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Der var nogle intro/informations arrangementer ULB afholdte så man kunne få den info man havde brug for + de svarede ret hurtigt på spørgsmål over mail.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det var ok nemt. Jeg fandt en lejlighed sammen med andre statskundskabsstuderende på Facebook. Der var også mange der boede i co-living som et firma arrangerer

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Der er ikke rigtig on-campus så alle bor off campus

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg fandt en lejlighed sammen med to andre statskundskabsstuderende fra KU via facebook. Det var min oplevelse at der var ok gode muligheder. Mange af mine erasmus venner boede i co-living lejligheder.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Der var ikke så meget man skulle gøre. Det sværeste var klart alt det inden via KU. På ULB skulle man bare sende ens endelige fag via mail.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Der var rigeligt af folk tilknyttet Erasmus studerende.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Det var ret ligetil. I den første uge kunne man bare 'shoppe' rundt og prøve forskellige fag også vælge endeligt bagefter. Vi havde ikke nogen problemer med at der var nogen der var fyldte eller noget. Det eneste er at ULB har en regel om at man kun må tage 2 masters fag, hvis man selv er på Bachelor, hvilket kan være svært at få til at gå op hvis man kun vil have fag på engelsk og er statskundskabsstuderende, der skal have dækket DAK og EP

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Gør det ahha

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Altsåååå fagene var lidt af blandet kvalitet, men det var fint

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Det var MEGET blandet hvad niveauet var. Måden at studere på er bare også meget anderledes fordi eksaminer er i hånden + udenadslære. Men syntes sagtens man kunne følge med uden at læse hele pensum:)

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Nogenlunde det samme.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Introduction to Political Science (BA)
Introduction to Political Communication (BA)
Introduction to EU politics (BA)
Globalization studies (MA)
Decision-Making in the EU (MA)
Democratization and Autocratization (MA)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg kunne godt lide Globalization studies rent indholdsmæssigt. Men undervisningen var lidt kaotisk.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtigt noget. De her tal er altså hevet lidt ud af røven. Jeg lagde ikke et budget.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Fødevarer var low key ret dyre, men sådan ikke dyrere end DK

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Der var et sportstilbud på ULB hvor man kunne købe et medlemskab for 35 euro for et semester også tage til alt den sport man ville. Man meldte sig bare til på ugentlig basis. 
Derudover var der er en masse klubber, men det var jeg ikke rigtig en del af.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Gå til sport hvis du vil. Meget cute måde at snakke med lokale studerende på

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tage på Sounds og høre Jazz, hænge ud i Marollen og genbrugshoppe, drikke et glas naturvin.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var nemt. Ikke såååå anderledes end København. Bare flere french vibes

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Gå til noget - eller tag på dates

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig noget

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Det franske sprog, at man kan handle ind på grøntsagsmarkeder i løbet af ugen

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. tag et fransk kursus på uni. De tilbyder det gratis. Jeg gik til det 5 timer om ugen og elskede det
2. bo i Ixelles eller Saint-Gilles hvis muligt 
3. EU boblen er ikke Bruxelles. Det påvirker de færreste hverdag.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bare tag afsted. Hvis du har nogen spørgsmål kan du skrive til mig på instagram @saralaessoee

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At blive bedre til fransk, at hygge i et halvt år og møde nye søde venner.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: At nå alt det man gerne vil:)

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
